texts.title: The Tales of the Magicians (Papyrus Westcar)
texts.date_approx: Middle Kingdom composition; manuscript c. 1650-1550 BCE
texts.source: Papyrus Westcar, Berlin P 3033 (SMB photographs by Sandra Steiss, CC BY-SA 4.0) + TLA transliteration and hieroglyphs (CC BY-SA 4.0) + English of W. M. Flinders Petrie (1899, public domain)
texts.description: The stories told to King Khufu by his sons about the magicians Webaoner, Djadjaemankh and Djedi, ending with the birth of the first three kings of the 5th Dynasty, on the twelve columns of Papyrus Westcar (c. 1600 BCE).
